verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for an AI app-building platform, but the evidence pack documents no retention policies, retention periods, or account- or data-deletion controls. The only related evidence is generic CRUD on app entities and a Data page for browsing records. Those are developer building blocks for managing app data, not a retention or deletion capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
